title: Read a Specific Line
question: Print a one-based line number from a text file.
code:
from pathlib import Path
lines = Path('notes.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
line_number = int(input())
print(lines[line_number - 1] if 1 <= line_number <= len(lines) else 'Out of range')
explanation: Convert the one-based line number to a zero-based index.
